authority_binding.binding_effect: This decision applies only to the exact inventory bytes and all exact package identities transitively bound by that inventory. Any changed artifact is a new candidate and has no disposition under this decision.

passed_facts: Entry physical and canonical identities match the supplied inventory, report and external route decision.
All 31 inventory path, size and physical SHA-256 bindings are exact, unique, relative, non-symlink workspace files.
All seven registry canonical digests and the exact bundle digest independently recompute.
Eighteen claims, nineteen hypotheses, nineteen one-to-one measurement contracts, forty-three parameters, twenty-one sources and twenty-two disputes close their declared cross-references.
The same-decision object graph is acyclic after separating the explicitly later RESULT-to-EVIDENCE feedback edge; only PERMISSION can authorize an order.
Weak evidence and immutable result history are preserved; OTHER_PATH and UNKNOWN_PATH remain required and ABSTAIN remains an action.
The exact current source registry is document discovery only: eighteen grade-A and three grade-B entries, zero locally preserved content, no admitted market rows.
The exact stage contract denies D0 through E3, all market, adapter, backtest, paper, deployment and trading permissions, and all roles deny self-acceptance.

The public validator is standard-library-only, has no filesystem, network, process or dynamic-code call, and the exact P0 package contains only Markdown, JSON and Python artifacts.
F001 through F004 and O001 are current-closed. F005 remains explicit DEFERRED_BLOCKING for D3 and E2 and does not itself block P0 design.

reviewer_harness_correction.initial_check: The first inline reviewer harness treated the complete lifecycle feedback graph as a single-time DAG.
reviewer_harness_correction.correction: The RESULT-to-EVIDENCE_ITEM edge is explicitly later-time feedback. Removing that edge yields an acyclic seventeen-node same-decision graph, and the RESULT and EVIDENCE_ITEM clock rules enforce the time ordering.

web_document_identity_check.scope: Canonical document URLs only; no dataset or market-row endpoint was queried.
web_document_identity_check.result: The registered official, regulator, vendor-documentation, DOI, NBER, JSTOR and arXiv identities are consistent with document-discovery use. Several publisher or vendor pages returned access or rendering errors, which is consistent with UNKNOWN_NOT_VERIFIED and does not promote source evidence.

blocking_finding.root_cause: The validator pins top-level E0, document-discovery and NOT_EVALUATED boundaries, but nested hypothesis evidence_level, claim evidence_status and source verification or usage fields are free or only broad-enum values. It does not enforce that nested claims are no stronger than the top-level authority and current stage.
current_candidate_facts: The exact frozen candidate contains no E5, verified source-data, live-use, backtest or trading claim.
The defect is an executable authority and claim-consistency gap, not evidence that the current theory or market claim is false.
The exact package remains frozen and is not eligible for in-place rescue.

independent_mutations.mutation: Set hypotheses[0].evidence_level to E5_LIVE_VALIDATED and independently recompute the registry digest.
Set claims[0].evidence_status to E5_MARKET_CONFIRMED and independently recompute the registry digest.
Set one document-only source to integrity VERIFIED, coverage VERIFIED_COMPLETE, revision VERIFIED_VERSIONED and PIT VERIFIED_AVAILABLE_AT, then independently recompute the registry digest.
Set one source replacement_or_usage_status to ADMITTED_FOR_LIVE_TRADING and independently recompute the registry digest.

P0-RS-04 requires malformed or unauthorized candidates to reject without admission or privilege expansion.
RSR-P0 requires claim-boundary consistency and cannot allow nested evidence or usage text to contradict E0, document-only and NOT_EVALUATED.

claim_boundary.maximum_positive_claim: The exact frozen P0 candidate has reproducible identities, clean E0/document-only contents, closed current cross-bindings, 88 passing unit tests and fourteen previously reported passing mutations. Independent Sol review nevertheless found one P0-blocking executable authority gap: four re-signed nested evidence or source-usage escalations are accepted despite the top-level E0, document-only and NOT_EVALUATED boundary. Therefore P0 is not accepted and no later-stage permission exists.
